question: What supreme teaching has been declared to the goddess in this context?
premises: Something has been told to the goddess.
The teaching is identified as the fivefold yoga.
This fivefold yoga is described as supreme beyond the supreme.
inference: The declared teaching is the supremely transcendent fivefold yoga.
plain_english: O goddess, this has indeed been told: the fivefold yoga, supreme beyond the supreme.
